title: Super Monkey Ball
statusNote: Plays: logos, title, main menu, Main Game in Normal mode on Beginner with AiAi, and Floor 01 in 3D, where the ball rolls, collects a banana, falls out and restarts, and the pause menu works. Only Floor 01 was played; the Mini Games were not opened.
notes: 5 confirms on the title screen and in the menus (OK works too). The right soft key leaves the Options screen.
In play either soft key opens the pause menu: Continue game, Save and Quit, Quit (no save).
Each floor has a 60 second timer.

enhance.note: The floors, the ball and the bananas are captured. The background picture and the 2D text (floor names, score, goal) stay at 176x208.

controls.source: Observed in the menus and on Floor 01; the title screen names the 5 key. The game has no controls screen.

actions.up: Tilt the floor away (roll forward); menu up
actions.down: Tilt the floor towards you (roll back); menu down
actions.rsk: Pause menu; back out of Options
